extracted.name: Cauliflower Purée
extracted.description: Try this cauliflower purée recipe when you want mashed potatoes but don't want all the calories or carbs. Dinner guests might not notice the difference!
instruction_lines: Bring a 4-quart pot of salted water to a boil; add cauliflower and simmer until tender, 7 to 10 minutes. Drain, reserving 1 cup cooking liquid.
Blend cauliflower and 1/4 cup cooking liquid in a blender until smooth, adding more water until desired consistency is reached. Add butter and pulse until incorporated; season with salt.
